question: restaurants in alfama bounding box
sql: SELECT names.primary, basic_category FROM lisbon_places WHERE basic_category = 'restaurant' AND ST_Within(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-9.135, 38.710, -9.125, 38.720))

question: buildings within 300m of praça do comércio
sql: SELECT names.primary, height, num_floors FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE ST_DWithin_Spheroid(ST_Centroid(geometry), ST_Point(-9.1393, 38.7077), 300)

question: pois inside torre vts algés building
sql: SELECT p.names.primary, p.basic_category FROM lisbon_places p JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Within(p.geometry, b.geometry) WHERE b.names.primary = 'Torre VTS de Algés'

question: buildings intersecting custom polygon
sql: SELECT names.primary, subtype, height FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON((-9.15 38.71, -9.13 38.71, -9.13 38.73, -9.15 38.73, -9.15 38.71))'))

question: buildings containing multiple pois
sql: SELECT b.names.primary, b.subtype, COUNT(*) as poi_count FROM lisbon_buildings b JOIN lisbon_places p ON ST_Contains(b.geometry, p.geometry) GROUP BY b.names.primary, b.subtype HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY poi_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: buildings touching polygon boundary
sql: SELECT names.primary, subtype FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE ST_Touches(geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON((-9.14 38.71, -9.12 38.71, -9.12 38.73, -9.14 38.73, -9.14 38.71))'))
